verdict.rationale: Langfuse explicitly documents side-by-side comparison of experiment runs to catch regressions across prompt, model, retrieval, or code changes (docs-12, docs-58), backed by CI/CD gating on regressions (docs-13/25/43) and dataset-based experiments (docs-8/21/27). Community evidence corroborates strong tracing/eval workflows in practice (langfuse-comm-6, langfuse-comm-7). missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of the side-by-side comparison UI/UX (vs. general praise), and no evidence addressing edge cases like large-scale run comparisons or any reported friction with this specific feature.
